description:
Use the ArkCase Global Search to find a specific Complaint case. We have received intelligence about a case involving the code phrase 'Project Blue Sky <UNIQUE_ID>'. You do not know the Case ID or the Title. 

Your goal is to:
1. Search for the phrase 'Project Blue Sky' (or the full code provided in the starting note) using the Global Search bar.
2. Locate the case in the search results.
3. Open the case and identify its Case ID (e.g., COMP-202X-XXXXX).
4. Save ONLY the Case ID into a text file at '/home/ga/found_case_id.txt'.
